title: Cancelled booking refunds split across travelers
name: Booking refund poster

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code computes and records refund amounts? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A cancelled booking has Total 10,001 cents and FeeBps 1,500. What fee and refundable amount does Refund compute before splitting?
The refund request times out at the client, which retries after the first call actually posted. What does the second Refund call do?
choices: Posts a second journal and refunds the travelers twice.
Returns ErrNotCancelled, because refunding changes the booking status.
Builds the same journal key, receives ErrDuplicate from the ledger and returns nil without posting again.

questions.prompt: Refund is called for a cancelled booking whose Travelers slice is empty. What happens?
choices: ErrNoTravelers is returned before any splitting or ledger call.
splitEven panics with an integer divide by zero.
A journal containing only the fee and liability entries is posted.
The full amount is refunded to a default account.
